name: Smuggler
summary: Smugglers specialize in moving contraband from one area to another while avoiding detection by authorities.

features.name: Bribery
features.summary: An experienced smuggler knows how to smooth over interactions with customs officials. At 3rd level, when dealing with officials working at a checkpoint, conducting an inspection, or performing another such activity, a smuggler can make a Diplomacy check opposed by the presiding official’s Sense Motive check to ensure her contraband makes it through. She gains a +1 bonus on this Diplomacy check. On a successful check, the smuggler pays a small bribe (5d4 gp) to guarantee her cargo remains undisturbed. This bonus rises to +2 when the smuggler reaches 6th level, +3 at 9th level, +4 at 12th level, +5 at 15th level, and +6 at 18th level. This ability replaces trap sense.

features.name: Conceal Item
features.summary: A smuggler adds 1/2 her level on Sleight of Hand checks (minimum +1). A smuggler can use Sleight of Hand to conceal a small item in a container or room, such as the false bottom of a chest or beneath floorboards. Anyone attempting to find an item concealed by a smuggler makes a Perception check opposed by the Sleight of Hand check made by the smuggler when she concealed the object. This ability replaces trapfinding.

features.name: Distraction
features.summary: A smuggler uses patter and body language to deflect searchers from hidden items. At 2nd level, a smuggler may make a Bluff check opposed by a searcher’s Perception check when a searcher looks for items the smuggler has concealed. If the smuggler’s Bluff check succeeds, the searcher must make a second Perception check and take the lower of the two rolls. This ability replaces Evasion.

resourceActions.label: Resolve Distraction
resourceActions.summary: Reroll the searcher's Perception check and use the lower of the original and new rolls.

skillBonusAdjustments.condition: dealing with officials at a checkpoint, inspection, or similar activity

mechanicalNotes: Bribery and Conceal Item apply their exact level-scaled skill bonuses. A successful Bribery check unlocks the 5d4 gp cost roll, while a successful Distraction check unlocks the required Perception reroll and retains the lower result.
